name: matsumoto-castle
documented_evidence: Official municipal pamphlet explicitly labels Tenshu29.4m, InuiKotenshu16.8m, WatariYagura12m, TatsumiTsukeYagura14.7m and TsukimiYagura11.1m. It identifies black walls, five apparent exterior stories but six interior floors, northwest small keep and southeast/ moonviewing extensions.
modeling_qualifications: Lower-only plaza cuts remove a spatially blurred DSM keep mound extending beyond the footprint. Osaka surveyed honmaru31.2–31.5m contrasts with production50–56m near the keep and39.8m65m west; Matsumoto surrounding ground590.5m contrasts with598–599m mound. Mapped retaining walls bound the core plaza; feathering transitions outside it and lower moat terrain is retained. Stone batter and architecture are unchanged. Terrain-cut polygons do not expand building/tree suppression; the surrounding park buildings remain native.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
